caption: Setup wizard step 4 of 5: 'Send a welcome email to the employee' is ticked by default before any employee is added.
Settings > Billing during the trial: Pro, paid annually, $6.99 per employee a month plus a $19.00 base fee, next billing date 11/12/2026, no card added; the receipt email address is hidden.
Change Plan screen: Starter $4.99, Pro $6.99 and Advanced $12.99 per employee a month, each plus a $19.00 base fee, with a 'Switch now' button to move down to Starter.
Employee list after adding two made-up employees with accented names and the welcome email unticked: both invites show 'Not sent'.
Employee import template: 8 fixed columns (Username, First Name, Last Name, Email Address, Password, Employee ID, Time Zone, Pin) and no column for free text or custom fields.
Opening the Employee Profile Details report leads to the Advanced Reporting add-on at $2 per user a month, included in the Advanced and Enterprise plans.
Time card for test employee TEST Zoë Alpha: one shift from 9:00 to 10:30 AM entered by hand shows 1.500 regular hours, the same figure as in the hours export; the IP addresses are hidden.

Retest 19 November 2026, Settings > Billing: Free trial, 7 days left, Pro, paid annually, $6.99 per employee a month plus a $19.00 base fee, next billing date 11/26/2026 after Buddy Punch extended our trial; no card or bank account added. The receipt address is hidden.
Retest 19 November 2026, Time Cards for the October 2026 pay period: our two made-up employees still show 2.000 and 1.500 hours.
Retest 19 November 2026, Reports > Payroll Export with Run Report, Export to Excel and Schedule this report; the file was not downloaded again.

Retest 19 November 2026, Import Employees: 'Add up to 100 employees at once from a spreadsheet', a CSV template with eight columns in a fixed order (Username, First Name, Last Name, Email Address and Password required) and an onboarding call with a Buddy Punch expert for 100+ employees.
